settings.restartHint: This change is written to the config file and needs a proxy restart to take effect.
settings.envHint: ZCODE_ environment variables win over the config file.
settings.description: Global configuration for the proxy runtime, connections, identity and services.
settings.advanced.title: Advanced
settings.saved.restart: Saved. Port and bind-address changes need a proxy restart to take effect.
settings.writtenNotApplied: The setting was written to the config file but is not in effect: the file as a whole failed validation. Please check the file and fix the error.
settings.defaultModel.hint: Used when a client request omits the model.
settings.clientIdentityMode.hint: Infers sessions from request content so one conversation keeps a stable session id (cache affinity, and closer to the official client).
settings.reasoningMode.hint: Passthrough: the client decides, the proxy never rewrites. Override: every reasoning-model request goes out at the tier selected below.
settings.reasoningEffort.hint: Applies in override mode only; stored but inert in passthrough. Off = thinking disabled (honored by glm-5.3-flash; plain glm-5.3 cannot truly disable thinking upstream, so it behaves like the lowest tier).
settings.clientIdentityTtl.hint: An inferred session expires after this much inactivity; later requests count as a new session.
settings.clientIdentityMaxSessions.hint: How many sessions to remember at once; the oldest unused ones are evicted. This caps this process's memory.
settings.normalizeClientSystem.hint: Rewrites identity statements like “You are Claude” into ZCode so upstream does not read the request as a forgery. Read-only: currently controlled by an environment variable.
settings.appVersion.hint: Typing a version by hand is only safe when this machine really has that version. An invented new number is worse than an old one: upstream has never seen it and reads it as a forgery.
settings.appVersion.placeholder: Leave empty to detect the local client
settings.appVersion.source.default: Source: built-in default (no local client detected)
settings.appVersion.invalid: The version must be x.y.z, three numeric parts.
settings.appVersion.notDetected: No local ZCode client found. You can type a version, but that is only safe when this machine really has it.
settings.highspeed.hint: While requests are active, draws an highspeed card per account in the background; a hit speeds up that account's replies. Stops after five idle minutes.
settings.highspeed.hint.detail: About one heartbeat request per second; a hit routes that account through the upstream accelerated endpoint; idle for about five minutes and it stops.
settings.mcp.hint: Aggregates every official plugin's tools behind one /mcp endpoint.
settings.mcp.hint.detail: Covers the whole official catalogue (Tianyancha, Wind, iFinD and more); tools are named {plugin}__{tool}; calls spend the account's paid data entitlements.
settings.async.hint: /async/v1/* joins the upstream off-peak queue without spending plan quota — meant for background jobs.
settings.async.hint.detail: Runs when the cluster has spare capacity; waits can be long.
settings.claim.hint: Periodically checks claimable limited plans per account and claims one the moment it opens.
settings.claim.hint.detail: Limited plans come from weekend / trial campaigns; claimed quota lands on the account; needs a logged-in account and may solve a captcha.
settings.dump.hint: Record the full context of every request (including request/response bodies) to a debug file. Takes effect immediately.
settings.dump.risk: The dump file contains full request bodies and may include prompt content. Turn it on only while debugging.
settings.quotaPollSeconds.hint: Samples every account's quota usage at this interval, feeding drain marking and recovery; idle accounts are skipped.
settings.quotaDrainThreshold.hint: Once an account reaches this share of usage it is marked drained and unscheduled until the quota resets.
settings.quotaDrainThreshold.hint.detail: 1 = only stop at 100% used; 0.9 = stop early at 90% (conservative).
settings.port.hint: The proxy and the control plane share this one listening port.
settings.host.hint: A non-loopback address exposes the control plane to the network.
settings.requireKey.hint: With this off, anyone who can reach this port can use the proxy. Keys are managed on the API keys page.
settings.import.hint: A ZCode credential file or an export bundle.
settings.import.fileRequired: Choose a file to import first.
settings.import.fileUnreadable: Could not read that file; please choose it again.
settings.export.hint: An export downloads a JSON file; a plaintext export needs you to type EXPORT, and the masked format only lists accounts.
settings.export.doneMasked: Exported a masked list of {{count}} account(s) (no file).
settings.export.confirmText: A plaintext export downloads the credentials verbatim; anyone who can read that file can use them.
settings.export.confirmWarn: The download's file mode is up to the OS; encrypt or delete it as soon as you are done.
settings.export.tokenMismatch: Type EXPORT to confirm the plaintext export.
settings.export.passwordRequired: An encrypted export needs a password.
settings.invalidHost: The bind address cannot be empty.
settings.host.confirmText: After binding to {{host}}, anyone who can reach that address can open the control plane.
settings.host.confirmWarn: Only do this if you really need access from another machine.
settings.requireKey.confirmOnText: After this, requests without a key (or a panel session) get a 401. While no key exists yet, requests still pass.
settings.requireKey.confirmOffText: With this off, anyone who can reach this port can use the proxy without any credentials.
settings.requireKey.confirmWarn: Written to the config file; takes effect immediately (the auth switch is read on every request).
error.confirmation_required: This change needs a second confirmation.
settings.about.checkUpdate.hint: Asks upstream only; changes no local file.
settings.shutdown.hint: Stops this program, control panel included. Start it again from the terminal or the container.
system.shutdown.confirmText: The proxy and the control panel shut down together, and this page loses its connection.
system.shutdown.confirmWarn: To bring the service back, restart it from the terminal, Docker, or your service manager.
system.shutdown.done: It's down. You can close this tab.
system.checkUpdate.unavailable: Cannot check for updates (offline, blocked, or the check is disabled).
chat.description: Talk to the proxy pipeline directly; replies stream in and sessions are kept in this browser so you can switch and continue them.
chat.settingsHint: "Panel session (default)" sends with the browser's login state and attributes usage to the panel session; a chosen key is sent as the Authorization header with its full value, attributing usage to that key. Manually pasted keys only ever live in this browser.

chat.empty.title: No messages yet
chat.empty.hint: Send a message to try the proxy.
chat.inputHint: Type a message; Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line
chat.error.models: Could not read the model list. Check the API key or panel sign-in, then retry with the top-bar refresh; see the system logs on the logs page for the cause.
chat.error.unauthorized: The proxy requires an API key: pick "Enter manually…" and paste a full key, or sign in to the panel again.
chat.error.stream: The stream broke. Send the message again; see the request events on the logs page for the cause.
chat.error.limit: This session has reached the limit of {{count}} messages; start a new session to continue.
chat.error.keyMissing: This key has no full value yet: paste the full key you saved when creating it, then send.
chat.warn.storage: Chat history is near the browser's storage limit (about 5 MB): delete old sessions to free space.
chat.selectors.title: Connection
chat.imageMissing: (image {{name}} is no longer stored on this machine)
chat.error.imageTooLarge: Image "{{name}}" exceeds the {{limit}} limit; it was not attached.
chat.error.fileTooLarge: Text file "{{name}}" exceeds {{limit}} (text content is injected into the conversation, hence the small cap). Attached the first {{truncated}} instead; see the original file for the rest.
chat.error.fileUnsupported: "{{name}}" is not a supported type: only images and text-like files (code / text / md / json) are accepted.
chat.error.attachLimit: A message carries at most {{count}} attachments.
chat.error.fileRead: Could not read the contents of "{{name}}".
chat.warn.vision: Model {{model}} does not accept image input: remove the images or switch to a vision model (e.g. glm-5.3-flash) before sending.
chat.warn.imageSessionOnly: The browser's image storage is unavailable (private mode or full quota): images attached this session only live on this page and disappear after a reload.
chat.warn.idbQuota: The browser's image storage is full: "{{name}}" only lives on this page and disappears after a reload.
